message.reasoning_content:
We need answer JSON only. Need evaluate every story 69 for Well-formed: includes at least role and means (functionality). Violation when either stakeholder role or requested functionality cannot be identified from core story text. We need classify each. Need be careful. We don't rewrite, just classify. Need maybe some stories malformed duplicates etc. Need decide for each.

Need parse each story. Criterion: Syntactic individual. Need role and means. User story format "As a <role>, I want <means>, so that <benefit>." Well-formed if role and means identifiable. Even if role weird "anonymoususer" is role. Means usually after "I want to ...". If no clear "I want to" maybe but means can be inferred? Need use core story text. Violation when either role or requested functionality cannot be identified.

Need identify any story lacking role? all have As a. Means? Some have multiple, malformed "so that so that". That's not syntactic role/means necessarily. Need focus role and means. Could some story's "I want" phrase not include actual functionality? E.g. BC-005 "I want to edit my training node myself, so that the training coordinators don't have to and links to slides." Means is edit training node. Role trainer. Well-formed. BC-006 "As a trainee, I want to limit to one registration per day per authenticated user" role trainee, means limit registration. Well-formed maybe role mismatched? Not criterion. BC-007: role trainingcoordinator, means have admin view tracking registration status. yes. BC-008 role attendee, means be added to waitlist. yes. BC-009 role trainee, means accept cancellation terms with checkbox. yes. BC-010 role trainingcoordinator, means tie cancellation deadline. yes.
